title: DMC3 HD canonical Phase 12 executable target

records.title: Executable platform identity
records.summary: The canonical research target is a Windows PE32+ x86-64 GUI executable.

locations.note: The canonical artifact size is 6,356,432 bytes. The previously recorded 3,735,552-byte size was corrected by direct SHA-256-matched artifact readback.

records.title: Executable entry point
records.summary: The canonical target entry point is VA 0x14034615C, RVA 0x34615C.

records.title: dmc3_main export
records.summary: The exported dmc3_main function is located at VA 0x1402C5DF0, RVA 0x2C5DF0.

records.title: Stage resource table
records.summary: The canonical executable contains a 110 x 4 stage resource path table at file offset 0x5C30A8 / RVA 0x5C4AA8 / VA 0x1405C4AA8. Each of the 440 observed cells has stride 0x10 and a relocatable 64-bit path pointer at cell +0x00. All 440 pointers resolve to bounded NUL-terminated ASCII paths matching the four column roles. Bytes at cell +0x08 are intentionally left semantically unresolved.

locations.note: 440 DIR64 relocation sites occur at the path-pointer field with exact 0x10 stride. Recorded role order: scr\stXXX.pac, room\stXXXcfg.pac, room\stXXX_effect.pac, se\snd_rXXX.pac. The +0x08 bytes are not assigned a meaning by this claim.

records.title: Observed stage resource row set
records.summary: The 110 script-column paths expose 110 distinct observed stage tokens arranged in four contiguous numeric blocks: 000-012, 100-146, 200-241, and 300-307. This records table content only and does not claim that every row is a semantically independent gameplay stage.

locations.note: Derived from the exact 110 x 4 table observation. Aliases, shared resources, service rows, and higher-level stage semantics remain separate reverse-engineering questions.

records.title: StageSet token classifier
records.summary: The function at VA 0x140246680 classifies StageSet tokens into runtime enum values. The public migration record confirms DUMMY=1, STAY=2, BREAK=3, ORBREAK=4, SEAL=5, and SWITCH=6; the remaining map is incomplete.

locations.note: Function identity is confirmed; the enum map remains partial.
